ledger.problem: Maintenance of sexual reproduction. What are the fundamental selective forces maintaining sexual reproduction?
ledger.description: Red Queen: parasites track common asexual clones, so common clones become disproportionately infected and are replaced by initially rare clones, periodically favouring genetically diverse sexuals (source). Quantitative form added here: sexuals persist if the time-averaged (geometric-mean) relative fitness of asexuals, after parasite-induced reduction, is <= 1/2 of its parasite-free value.
